drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodNiacin 9mgVitamin A 450μgVitamin B1 0.84mgVitamin B6 1.08mgVitamin C 50mgVitamin E 7mgSelenium 35μgZinc 5mgPantothenic acid 3.6mgOnce a day

면역튼튼 비타구미Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)에스디푸드 · Once a day · 3 gummys

This product combines 9mg of Niacin, 450μg of Vitamin A, 0.84mg of Vitamin B1, 1.08mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 7mg of Vitamin E, 35μg of Selenium, 5mg of Zinc, 3.6mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (3 gummys): 9mg Niacin, 450μg Vitamin A, 0.84mg Vitamin B1, 1.08mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 7mg Vitamin E, 35μg Selenium, 5mg Zinc, 3.6mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)에스디푸드

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day3 gummys per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (9mg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (450μg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.84mg / 10.8g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.08mg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (50mg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (7mg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (35μg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (5mg / 10.8g), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (3.6mg / 10.8g), 80~180%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유한 향미가 있는 보라색의 반원 모양 젤리
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18개월까지
Storage 1. 제품이 고온에 약하니 직사광선을 피하여 30 ℃ 이하의 온도, 습도가 낮은 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 제품 개봉 후에는 밀봉하여 보관하시고 가급적 빨리 섭취하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
